title: The Billionaire Who Paid His Taxes With a Painting
hook: A billionaire used a single abstract painting to wipe out $100 million in tax debt, and the government had to accept it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurdity of paying taxes with art feels like a cheat code, making viewers desperate to understand how it works.

title: The Algorithm That Hunts for Undeclared Gold Teeth
hook: A secret algorithm scans dental X-rays to find people hiding gold teeth from tax authorities.
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurd specificity of detecting gold in teeth is both shocking and morbidly funny, driving clicks.

why_this_can_go_viral: The ethical horror of manipulating the ultra-rich for their own 'good' taps into schadenfreude and curiosity.
